publishedRecipe.name: Turkey-Basil Fettuccine with Bell Peppers & Broccoli

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes; drain and set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 red bell peppers
2 crowns broccoli
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers into thin strips; place in a medium bowl.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom; add turkey and cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp butter, unsalted
1 ½ lb ground turkey

instructions.primary_message: While the turkey is cooking, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
When the turkey is done, add veggies to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender-crisp, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
When the veggies are done, sprinkle with flour and continue to cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add milk, salt, and pepper to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
8 fl oz (1 cup) whole milk
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add drained pasta and basil to the skillet; toss to combine and remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
